body:
## Problem and current result

XYZ #757 needs a fresh, repository-grouped next-action evaluation before another model ranking is credible. This draft registers the task in RELEASES/PDDA and retains a reproducible Phase 0 development-data probe. It makes no model-quality claim.

After excluding prior-window repositories/issues, 81 resolved trajectories from 74 repositories yielded 648 evenly sampled development rows with all six action labels. The receipt records exact counts, sampling, serializer hash and remaining audit gates.

The operator volunteered to judge a 20-case, three-choice useful-advice pilot. [The questionnaire is posted on #757](https://github.com/HiQS-Labs/XYZ-forge/issues/757#issuecomment-5789038344); a sanitized selection manifest pins the 20 distinct repositories and pre-action states. Contract B remains unscored until answers arrive and are frozen. This pilot alone cannot authorize an advisory handoff. Contract A is not yet frozen or scored.

## Validation

- Receipt arithmetic, manifest distinctness, JSON and Python syntax pass.
- `releases_app.py check`: 0 failures (9 pre-existing warnings).
- Initial tier-2 push gate green with the required toolchain; latest documentation push gate green. Focused `gh549-work-events.sh` passed 124/124 on clean `development` and on this branch.

Closes no issue. Keep this PR draft until the Phase 0 gates and frozen evaluation are complete.
